verdict.rationale: Granola documents a first-party CSV export, an open format, that covers note titles, summaries, transcripts and "other basic details," and explicitly frames it for backups, migration and GDPR data portability. A REST API also gives programmatic access to notes, transcripts and AI summaries. However, the export is described as covering only basic details, so whether it includes *all* data is unproven. Missing for 10: evidence that the export covers screenshots, raw notes, folders, templates and recipes; richer open formats such as Markdown or JSON; and independent or hands-on confirmation of a complete migration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Export your Granola meeting notes to CSV. Get note titles, summaries, transcripts, and details. Useful for backups, migration, or GDPR data portability requests.
The CSV includes the title, note summary, transcript, and other basic details for each note.
You're able to export historical data from Granola by going to Settings, clicking Profile in the sidebar (under Preferences), and clicking Generate CSV
The Granola API lets you build custom integrations with programmatic access to meeting notes, transcripts, and AI summaries.
